verdict.rationale: User approved plan: 4 test-first tasks covering async repo lookup, response models, summation core, and the read-only rollup endpoint.

User requested fix-up for all 5 findings: CR-001/002 code-quality (license header, typing), CR-003/004/005 billing correctness (provider_sync_status, budget_duration window mixing, member_count double-counting).
User approved fix-up round (commit 23eb88ae7) closing all 5 findings: CR-001/002 code-quality, CR-003/004/005 billing correctness (provider_sync_status, budget_duration windows, member_count dedup).

qa-gates blocked_gate=test (3 failures) accepted as pre-existing/environment: test_hedged_handler.py::test_yields_exactly_one_chunk passes in isolation (order-dependent flake, not touched by this branch); test_filesystem_policy.py matplotlib/openpyxl guard tests fail even in isolation with subprocess signal -2 in an unrelated sandboxed code-executor module never touched by this diff. All other gates (lint, build, license, secrets) passed. Verified by running the 3 tests in isolation on current branch and comparing behavior.

Yana Asadchaya's post-rebase review (after commit 7b611766c, not covered by the gate-run.json/decisions.jsonl entries above which describe the unreachable pre-rebase commit 23eb88ae7) raised 10 findings. Resolved with product decisions from the MR author: duration-mismatch rows now surface an excluded_count instead of being silently dropped; categories with every row pending/failed sync now surface an unsynced_count instead of disappearing; current_spending now includes key spend for parity with the project page (reusing project_spending_service's bulk key-row helpers); budget_limit/total_percent are suppressed/clamped when categories disagree on budget_duration; member_count is now scoped to the same accepted budget_ids the money totals used; the async handler no longer blocks the event loop on a sync session; the router reuses aget_project_names_by_cost_center_name instead of a join-less duplicate; the stale docstring file reference is fixed. Verified via targeted pytest (55 passed) and OpenAPI baseline regeneration scoped to the touched schemas. gate-run.json was not re-run in full (no CI pipeline exists for this repo per AGENTS.md); make test-harness on current HEAD is the authoritative result, pasted into the MR description.
